scope: 继续上次标注、两侧按钮间序号回车跳转、N清框并标记负样本

implementation.progress_storage: Current browser localStorage, keyed by tenant ID, user ID and project ID; stores last successfully opened asset ID and filename
implementation.resume_validation: GET asset and verify project before navigating; 404 or project mismatch clears bookmark, network failure retains it
implementation.ordinal_input: Replaces current position between previous/next; Enter submits; no extra jump button
implementation.negative_shortcut: N or visible negative button clears all boxes and confirms negative in one undoable draft edit; saved manually or before image navigation

browser_checks: One neighbor request locates current image without project list scan
Previous and next without unnecessary saves
Edited box saves once before next
HTTP 500 preserves current image and draft
HTTP 409 preserves current image and draft
First/last boundaries and review return filters
N clears boxes and confirms negative; undo restores both
Input ignores workbench shortcuts; Enter jumps
Ordinal save conflict keeps draft and actual position; retry succeeds
Four project entries resume same image; refresh retains position
Empty ordinal makes no request; lookup HTTP 503 retains image and retries
N ignored while shortcut dialog open
Resume network failure retains bookmark and retries
Deleted bookmarked asset clears current project bookmark
Historical version rejects N and disables negative action
tests.build: TypeScript, main and SmartEye entries passed
tests.reason_backend_suite_not_rerun: Frontend-only change reuses existing validated endpoints

live_readonly.concurrent_user_changes: Compared with previous task baseline, 2 additional annotation records/events plus project/asset updates were observed; kept intact, never rolled back. Later progress-specific baseline matches final tables.
live_readonly.browser_authentication: Expired test browser credential refreshed privately without database writes, then checks rerun

limits: Progress is local to current browser; no synchronization across devices or browsers
Position persistence does not save unsubmitted annotation drafts
N clears local boxes immediately; undo is available until save/reload/image or history change
Positions may change when project images are added or removed
Real annotation save and destructive negative writes were intercepted rather than sent to business database
Million-image performance and additional browsers were not tested
